lessons: In lift_outbox, validate a registered artifact only when this lift will carry it: kind == "checks" AND the file passes the written/only filter. Non-checks lifts (run-record, harvest, diagnosis) must skip registered files entirely and never raise ArtifactInvalid.

When check returns gate_failed on ArtifactInvalid, delete the invalid registered artifact from the outbox so the later harvest and write_diagnosis lifts proceed instead of re-raising or crashing drive.

Add a test where the Implement agent writes an invalid shakeout-report.json and the run-record lift still completes. Add another where a failed Check's invalid report flows through harvest and diagnosis without an exception.
Strengthen the AC1 invalid-report test: assert that tickets/<stem>/checks.json and the report are both absent from the repo, and that 'chupa(<stem>): checks' is not in subjects(repo).
